text: The blacksmith has sent some strange armour to our quartermaster. It seems to breathe softly, and when someone comes close it stirs and sniffs at them. The blacksmith says that to complete it, we must bathe it in the blood of many enemies. We should fulfil his request on our journey, my lord. Perhaps it will prove useful to us.
Giving Life To The Armour

My lord, the blacksmith sends us some strange armour again. A strange shape that seems forged from chains and scraps of troll skin appears before you. "This armour fills anyone who comes near it with dread." The quartermaster continues: "He told us that we must kill enemies with this armour nearby so it can take their souls. We should take it on our travels to finish it, my lord."
Binding Souls To The Armour

My lord, the blacksmith sends us an unfinished sword this time. He wishes us to blood it in battle, to imbue it with the spirit of cold. The blade looks more like a shard of solid glass than steel. Just looking at it sends an icy shiver down your spine. The quartermaster continues: "He told us the blade will be complete once enough enemies have fallen to it. We should take it on our travels to finish it, my lord."

Blood the Steel

The master smith has sent us a blade that is not yet finished. "Steel only learns its edge in battle," he writes. Kill as many enemies as this mission names before the deadline, and he sends the reward named on it.\\n\\nFailing costs us nothing.
Test the Steel

The Smiths' Association wants proof that its steel holds against our nearest enemy. Beat as many armies of the faction this mission names as it asks before the deadline, and the master smith sends the reward named on it.\\n\\nFailing costs us nothing.
Fetch Star-Metal

A shard of star-metal has fallen near our Smithy, and others are already gathering around it. March a lord onto the marked site and win the battle there before the countdown runs out, and the master smith forges the reward named on this mission from it.\\n\\nFailing costs us nothing.
